hypothesis: A context-learning skill refined by Hermes (Haiku) from FIT-split failures only raises the CL-bench all-or-nothing solve rate by at least 0.10 versus the untouched base skill AND versus a wrong-source skill (systematic-debugging), on Claude Haiku 5.5, over a sealed assessment split the proposer never saw.
decision_rule: Units: assessment tasks, one run per arm. Score: primary judge all-or-nothing rubric grade (0/1). Contrasts: candidate minus untouched_base and candidate minus deterministic_random; cluster = task; seeded percentile bootstrap. Pass iff excluded/units <= max_notrun AND for BOTH contrasts lower bound > 0 AND mean >= min_effect. Second judge graded independently for instrument agreement. The Exchange then decides on all 13 lanes.
